e.title: PolicyExplainer AI
e.summary: 家财险保单 RAG 问答助手：只基于保单文本回答+引用来源+诚实拒答+真实评测框架
e.body: PolicyExplainer AI 是家财险保单的检索增强（RAG）问答助手：用自然语言回答保单问题（如『飓风免赔额多少』『洪水是否承保』）——答案只来自保单文本（绝不来自模型泛化知识），带页码引用；保单未覆盖的问题诚实拒答而非猜测；配备真实评测框架。对 RIAA：保险保单文档问答的最佳实践（grounded + 引用 + 拒答 + 评测）。与 [[underwriting-copilot]]（承保 copilot）、[[mongodb-insurance-pdf-search]]（PDF 检索）互补。关联 [[finixdocbench]]、[[claimpilot-harness]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：家财险保单 grounded RAG（只基于保单文本+引用+诚实拒答+评测框架）
e.summary_en: Homeowners-policy RAG Q&A assistant: answers grounded only in the policy text with citations, honest refusals and a real evaluation harness
e.summary_hk: 家財險保單 RAG 問答助手：只基於保單文本回答+引用來源+誠實拒答+真實評測框架
e.body_en: PolicyExplainer AI is a retrieval-augmented (RAG) assistant for homeowners-insurance policy Q&A: plain-language answers (e.g. 'What's my hurricane deductible?', 'Is flood damage covered?') — grounded only in the policy text (never the model's general knowledge), with page citations; honest refusals when the policy doesn't address the question; and a real evaluation harness. For RIAA: best practice for insurance policy-document Q&A (grounded + citations + refusals + evaluation). Complements [[underwriting-copilot]] (underwriting copilot) and [[mongodb-insurance-pdf-search]] (PDF retrieval). Related: [[finixdocbench]], [[claimpilot-harness]].
e.body_hk: PolicyExplainer AI 是家財險保單的檢索增強（RAG）問答助手：用自然語言回答保單問題（如『颶風免賠額多少』『洪水是否承保』）——答案只來自保單文本（絕不來自模型泛化知識），帶頁碼引用；保單未覆蓋的問題誠實拒答而非猜測；配備真實評測框架。對 RIAA：保險保單文檔問答的最佳實踐（grounded + 引用 + 拒答 + 評測）。與 [[underwriting-copilot]]（承保 copilot）、[[mongodb-insurance-pdf-search]]（PDF 檢索）互補。關聯 [[finixdocbench]]、[[claimpilot-harness]]。
